summary: knowledge-graph repo: benchmark retrieval with Recall@K and MRR

message.content: Add a benchmark to the knowledge graph repo that compares BM25, dense, hybrid and graph retrieval.

content.text: Added benchmarks/run.py: it builds an index per corpus, runs each question through every retrieval mode and reports Recall@5, Recall@10, MRR and nDCG@10 by question type. Graph retrieval uses Personalized PageRank seeded by the query's concepts and fused with BM25 and dense rankings through reciprocal rank fusion. Parameters are tuned on a dev split and reported on a held-out test split.

message.content: Graph mode is worse than BM25 on single-hop questions.

content.text: Expected: pure graph retrieval only knows concepts, so for exact lookups BM25 wins. That is why the default mode fuses all three signals; the graph contributes most on multi-hop questions. I also added IDF weighting so hub concepts no longer receive seed mass, which removed most of the noise.
